run_fuse_gmock: run fuse_gmock_files.py to fuse Google Mock and Google Test source code into three output files
run_fuse_gmock_with_root: run fuse_gmock_files.py with a custom GMOCK_ROOT_DIR and OUTPUT_DIR to generate fused header and source files
fuse_gmock_h: fuse all Google Mock header files recursively into a single gmock/gmock.h output file
fuse_gmock_gtest_all_cc: fuse gtest-all.cc and gmock-all.cc into a single gmock-gtest-all.cc combined source file
validate_gmock_root_dir: validate that a given directory is a valid Google Mock root directory with required seed files
